heading: Hey, I'm Abdiel!
paragraphs: I'm a Computer Engineering student @ Universitas Indonesia, currently learning and building projects around FPGA, AI, and web development.

Along the way, I became a laboratory assistant at DigiLab DTE FTUI, where I design case studies and pre-test problems for the Digital Systems Design course. I've also served as software and Kominfo staff for FTUI organizations, building websites and designing feeds for IME FTUI's social media.
I like web development, FPGA hardware architecture, cinematography, movies, and cats! (I really want to adopt one someday :3). I also enjoy recreating coffee shop drinks at home and playing games.
